title: PanTS-only long run: recover the project-course recipe and establish a reference for adding PANORAMA
purpose: Train a fresh SuPreM-initialized PanTS model at project-course scale, report historical context honestly, and establish a reproducible control for the subsequent PANORAMA-positive experiment.
correction: The qualified cohort contains 1333 train and 75 development cases. The previously reported 118/5 counts describe an ambiguous-provenance subset relevant to PANORAMA overlap, not the full cohort.

historical_comparators.title: Clean whole-box SuPreM baseline
historical_comparators.evaluation: provided union ROI, development 40 positive/40 reference-empty
historical_comparators.use: Primary historical recipe/performance reference, descriptive only without matched evaluation

historical_comparators.title: More reference-empty training cases, approximately 1:9
historical_comparators.outcome: Rejected: historical test specificity rose 17% to 46%, detection fell 96% to 88%, lesion Dice fell 0.474 to 0.374
historical_comparators.lesson: Do not adopt the 1:9 ratio; track small-lesion misses
historical_comparators.use: Historical context only; no test re-evaluation or threshold selection

historical_comparators.title: Head/body/tail auxiliary supervision
historical_comparators.outcome: Rejected at 24k: lesion gain uncertain, pancreas regression; promising 12k result overturned
historical_comparators.lesson: Use the plain three-class model and judge the declared endpoint

recommended_recipe.design: Historical-recipe-inspired current-cohort baseline; not an exact EXP-24 reproduction or single-factor comparison with it
recommended_recipe.initialization: Original released SuPreM backbone with fresh three-class head; no previous project or retired Lenovo trained model
recommended_recipe.source_limit: Existing accepted_for_development source review; upstream training/selection membership remains unverified

cohort.counts_status: Target-state class counts must be confirmed from current admitted ledger before freeze
cohort.preserve: Ordered admitted IDs, original roles and 84 historical exclusions

recommended_recipe.inputs: Reuse qualified 144-cubed physical-RAS provided-pancreas cache, 1 mm sampling setting, 10 mm margin, HU -100 to 250; effective geometry recorded per case
recommended_recipe.loss: Proposed MONAI DiceFocal: softmax, one-hot targets, include_background=false, gamma=2, lambda_dice=1, lambda_focal=1
recommended_recipe.loss_status: Requires a versioned optional loss path: current full session hardcodes normalized CE plus present-foreground Dice. Changing base YAML alone does not select DiceFocal. Preserve current loss and prior identities.
recommended_recipe.optimizer: AdamW, base learning rate 0.0001, weight decay 0.00001, batch size 1
recommended_recipe.sampling: Existing seeded full-cohort permutation; seed 42; one case per update, no additional positive oversampling
recommended_recipe.augmentation: None for this proposed baseline, matching the qualified cached full-session route; explicit difference from historical light augmentation
recommended_recipe.encoder: Train all layers from update 1; explicit difference from historical encoder-freeze warmup
recommended_recipe.schedule: 500-update linear warmup then existing cosine schedule over 24000 updates; no automatic extension
recommended_recipe.other_retention: Initial, rolling latest, best-development checkpoint and journal; explicitly preserve 8000 before rolling replacement
recommended_recipe.selection: Highest positive-case macro tensor-grid lesion Dice at scheduled evaluations; earliest step wins an exact tie. Report this selected model and terminal 24000 separately. Fixed endpoint comparison uses 8000 and 24000 only.

qualification.reuse: Existing 1408-case cache/content audit, original split checks, 3 CUDA updates/75 development evaluations, backup and cold continuation qualification; no complete rebuild or repeated source hashing
new_checks: Confirm current metadata identities and target-state counts
Implement and test only the proposed versioned DiceFocal path if recipe is selected
Check real selected SuPreM initialization compatibility without importing retired models
Qualify the changed loss with a bounded fresh CUDA smoke and recovery check, reusing existing input evidence
Confirm native restoration and proposed lesion/false-alarm metric definitions using focused fixtures
Verify milestone retention, run-specific output paths, storage allocation, AC and single-worker ownership
Freeze resolved configuration, code/environment and evidence hashes before launch
qualification.no_repeated_research_gates: No new two-case memorization study or short scientific training arm

measurement.primary_quality: Patient-macro raw lesion Dice across every development-positive case, including zero-Dice misses
measurement.routine: Existing tensor-grid metrics every 2000 updates; retain per-case values and voxel counts
measurement.endpoint_reporting: Restore predictions to native CT grids at fixed 8000 and 24000 and the selected checkpoint; score against original references, including lesion portions outside the supplied crop
measurement.prediction_rule: Three-class argmax; no TTA, threshold search, anatomical cleanup or largest-lesion-component pruning for primary Dice
measurement.case_detection: Proposed overlap-based detection: at least one native reference lesion component overlaps at least one predicted lesion voxel; report its limitation and lesion-wise count separately
measurement.lesion_detection: 26-connected native reference components with any predicted overlap; declare component matching rule in evaluator contract before freeze
measurement.false_alarms: Fraction of reference-empty cases with any predicted lesion, plus total predicted lesion volume and component count; 50 mm3 case-alert analysis reported separately for historical context
measurement.historical_detection_limit: Historical >=50 mm3 predicted-volume case positivity is not necessarily localized lesion detection. Never equate the two silently.
measurement.subgroups: Native lesion volume <1 cm3, 1-10 cm3, >10 cm3; source/phase where metadata exists; report denominators and missing metadata
measurement.uncertainty: Paired patient bootstrap, 10000 resamples, fixed seed 20261011, 95% percentile intervals; one training seed supports within-run conclusions only
measurement.evaluator_status: Native endpoint and component metrics require implementation/verification assessment before launch; existing tensor Dice and voxel counts alone do not satisfy this specification

hypotheses_and_decisions.baseline: Establish a measured reference; no fabricated superiority claim from a standalone run
hypotheses_and_decisions.secondary_prespecified_question: Does later training on this fixed trajectory improve native development lesion Dice from 8000 to 24000 without material detection or false-alarm deterioration?
hypotheses_and_decisions.proposed_accept: Dice difference >=0.02 and its paired 95% interval lower bound >0; case-detection difference >=-0.03 and false-alarm-rate difference <=0.03 on point estimates
hypotheses_and_decisions.guardrail_precision: If counts confirm 38 positives/37 empty references, a 3-percentage-point margin allows at most one net additional missed positive and one net additional false-alarm case. Report paired gained/lost cases and uncertainty. Point-estimate passage does not prove statistical noninferiority.
hypotheses_and_decisions.reject: At the valid full endpoint a guardrail point estimate breaches its margin, or the Dice interval upper bound is below the 0.02 practical improvement target
hypotheses_and_decisions.inconclusive: All other valid comparisons that fail the accept rule; particularly intervals too wide to distinguish useful improvement
hypotheses_and_decisions.failure: Invalid evaluation is invalid; interrupted/runtime-failed training is incomplete or operationally_failed; neither is scientific rejection
hypotheses_and_decisions.historical_comparison: Report new and old metrics with cohort, ROI, loss and metric differences adjacent. No causal improvement or benchmark equivalence claim against 0.415/0.474. A matched historical-recipe control would be a separate future experiment.

resources_and_operations.duration: 24000 updates is the endpoint. Proposed watchdog 24 elapsed active hours, not a prediction of runtime or requirement to waste compute until 24 hours.
resources_and_operations.backup: Independent C: copy within existing 27917287424-byte aggregate cap; verify space for milestones before launch
resources_and_operations.outputs: Fresh run-specific E: outputs and C: backup directories to be frozen with final configuration
resources_and_operations.stops: Nonfinite computation, invalid data/state, resource/AC/storage/checkpoint failure, watchdog, or user stop; no ad hoc early quality stop
resources_and_operations.resume: Explicit continuation from verified state into separate attempt after reconciliation; preserve interrupted journal and unsaved tail, no automatic retry
resources_and_operations.automation: No recurring AI checks or automatic successor runs configured by this specification
